title: Anyone else have a hostage situation mall dream on 3/11
content: Trigger warning: hostages, active shooter, death Did anyone else have a dream/ nightmare like this on 3/11 at 4am EST? I was at a mall where there was an active shooter. The mall was huge. Lots of floors, glass windows, huge crowded staircases. Huge open Floorplan. An armed man had everyone hostage with an elaborate planned "show". People everywhere, many trying to hide, but not many hiding spots so everyone was just kind of still and frozen in fear. A teenaged autistic boy near me interrupted the spectacle to ask for a "cold beverage" from a woman who was shakily walking around offering refreshments. She was doing this, as directed by him as part of the show he had planned. She was not working with him, but a hostage trying to obey to save herself. This boy's request angered the shooter because it interrupted the flow of the event, so he shot him. Then he saw me (I was hiding under a black metal bench.) He called me out by name and referenced the boy and before I could really respond, he shot me in the ear. I realized I had been shot but thought I wouldn't die, because I was lucid by this point, had never died in a dream before and I had realized I was in a dreamworld. Then, it became clear I was actually going to die within seconds. I managed to scream out a message to my sister before everything faded. When I abruptly woke up I was confused and panicked and couldn't transition into this reality for quite a while. I couldn't connect with this timeline or that one. I felt in limbo. I have never died in a dream. I was upset I couldn't get back to help etc. I do remember many more details of the mall, the shooter and the scene but this is the main concept. Note: the day after this, I started getting tiktoks in my algorithm about "mallworld" dreams that thousands of people share so that's what brought me to this thread!
